text: My family has to pay so much for my treatment, they would be better off financially if I were gone.
I'm just dragging everyone down with my problems.
They spend all their time worrying about me. I'm a burden on my kids.
I try not to be a burden, but I know I'm ruining their lives anyway.
It's not fair to my spouse to have to deal with me and my baggage.
I used to support my family, but now I just drain their resources.
I was independent once. Now I'm just a liability to everyone who loves me.
I'm such a great catch. Whoever is with me gets to pay my medical bills and deal with my crying.
I'm sure my kids just love spending their weekends taking care of me.
My dad told me, 'You're costing this family too much money and stress.'
I overheard them say 'Life would be so much easier if we didn't have to look after him.'
My existence just makes things harder for the people I care about.
If I wasn't around, my husband could finally be happy and debt-free.
I feel like a heavy weight tied around my family's neck.
They have to sacrifice so much just to keep me afloat.
I'm useless. All I do is consume time and money.
My friends are tired of listening to my issues. I'm just a drain on them.
I've ruined my family's life. They'd be relieved if I passed away.
I contribute nothing. I only take from others.
I'm nothing but a massive inconvenience to everyone.
